Method of Attack: File encryption using AES-256 (CBC-SALTED) for files smaller than 2,117,152 bytes
Filling files larger than 2,117,152 bytes with random bytes
Adding 'fuckazov' file extension to affected files
Deleting shadow copies to inhibit system recovery
Attack Vector: Emails focused on the Russia-Ukraine war
Indicators of Compromise: Encrypted files containing RSA encrypted passwords and base64 encoded AES encrypted content
